question: Does the vendor have a documented security program with a named security lead?
Can the vendor provide a current SOC 2 Type II report or ISO 27001 certificate that covers the service and region we would use?
Is personal health information stored and processed only in Canada?
Is data encrypted at rest with AES-256 or equivalent?
Are all connections protected with TLS 1.2 or higher?
Do vendor staff need MFA to reach customer data?
Can our users sign in with SSO and be given role-based access?
Are access logs for our data kept for at least 1 year and available on request?
Will the vendor notify us of a confirmed breach within 24 hours?
Does the vendor run yearly penetration tests and patch critical issues within a set deadline?
Is there a tested disaster recovery plan with stated recovery time and recovery point objectives?
Does the vendor publish its subprocessors and give notice before adding new ones?
Will the vendor return our data and certify deletion when the contract ends?
Are staff with access to customer data background checked?
Do vendor staff complete security awareness training every year?
